micah.6.p1.b1.text: Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.

micah.6.p1.b2.text: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth.

micah.6.p1.b3.text: My people, what have I done to you? Testify against Me how I have wearied you!

micah.6.p1.b4.text: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt … I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.

micah.6.p1.b5.text: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?

micah.6.p1.b6.text: Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

micah.6.p1.b7.text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

micah.6.p2.b1.text: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city … it is sound wisdom to fear Your name

micah.6.p2.b2.text: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?

micah.6.p2.b3.text: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?

micah.6.p2.b4.text: For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.

micah.6.p2.b5.text: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.

micah.6.p2.b6.text: You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house … Therefore I will make you a desolation
